title: The Crypt of Regrowing Glowcaps
story: Nullbarrow the Gravecap has sealed the old crypt door with 45 stubborn glowcaps, trapping three sleepy lantern-mice inside. Mr 6 can shear off 9 glowcaps in an hour — but Nullbarrow grins and sprouts 4 fresh ones back each hour. Mr 6 sits down to think before he swings even once.
question: If Mr 6 shears 9 glowcaps every hour and 4 regrow each hour, how many hours until all 45 glowcaps are gone?
solution: Each hour the door really loses 9 - 4 = 5 glowcaps.
In the ninth hour the last 5 caps come off and nothing regrows: 9 hours.
praise: Spotting that the regrowth changes everything is the real insight — the missing step was dividing 45 by the NET loss of 5 each hour.
hint: Before dividing, ask: after one full hour of shearing and regrowing, how many fewer glowcaps are on the door?
victory: The last glowcap pops off, the crypt door swings wide, and three lantern-mice scurry out blinking. Nullbarrow sighs, 'You counted the regrowth,' and shuffles off to sprout somewhere less mathematical.
imagePrompt: A cheerful numeral-six knight with a small helmet studying a stone crypt door crusted with glowing green mushroom caps while a lumpy fungus monster sprouts new ones, lit by soft teal mushroom light.
